summary: Vistra Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Vistra Operations Company LLC completed a $4.0 billion private offering of senior notes in four tranches due 2028–2036. The notes were sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. The indenture includes subsidiary guarantees. This is a straight debt financing, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring event; it is a routine capital markets transaction.
